_help: Add posts to 'posts'. Newest are shown first (sorted by date, YYYY-MM-DD). 'tag' is optional (e.g. Update, Event, Announcement). Use \n\n in 'body' for new paragraphs.

posts.title: MLG Rush is here, plus the Reducer
posts.body:
MLG Rush is now live! Click the MLG Rush NPC in the lobby or use the compass. Challenge a friend by hitting them with the Challenger sword, or join the 1v1 or 4-player FFA queue. Pick a map, break beds, and climb the trophy leagues from Wood to Master. Type /quit to end your match.

Clutches also got the Reducer: click the Reducer NPC in the Clutches lobby to train your knockback reduction in your own private arena, with adjustable countdown, hit strength, air hits and more.
